description: Cubic yards (and optional tons) of mulch, gravel, sand or soil for a bed or path. Formula: Cubic yards = L(ft) × W(ft) × depth(in) ÷ 324 (since 27 cu ft × 12 in = 324). Tons = cu yd × supplier density.

tons_per_cy.description: Material density from your supplier (0 = skip) (tons/cu yd); default 0
